headline: Tesla FSD v15 Rolls Out with Unified AI Architecture and Autonomous Garage Entry, Marking a 'Super' Intelligence Leap
reason: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) v15, rolling out to early access users, features a completely new AI architecture and demonstrates a significant step forward in handling unstructured, private-property environments with autonomous garage entry. This update includes a unified vision encoder shared across FSD, Robotaxi, and Optimus, suggesting a major architectural shift towards a single AI stack across Tesla's product lines, and a reported 25x improvement in safety for critical scenarios.

headline: Longevity Supplement Trends for 2026 Highlight NAD+ Precursors and Foundational Nutrients Backed by Human Trials
reason: While no new breakthrough human study was published in the last 24 hours, the latest scientific trends in longevity research for 2026 emphasize NAD+ precursors like NMN and NR for their ability to consistently raise blood NAD+ levels in human trials, along with foundational nutrients such as vitamin D, omega-3 fatty acids, magnesium, and B vitamins, which continue to have the most robust human trial data for healthspan and anti-aging benefits.

headline: Indian Equities See Record FPI Inflow, Erasing Half of 2026 Selloff in One Month
reason: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) made a record net investment of Rs 1.22 lakh crore in Indian equities from November 2 to November 20, 2026, exceeding previous highs and providing strong upward momentum. This significant inflow has effectively erased nearly half of the market's 2026 selloff, indicating a major positive macro shift in the Indian stock market.

headline: Claude Opus 5.5 Sets New Benchmark, Outperforming Human Engineers in Building AI Infrastructure
reason: The latest daily AI briefing reports that Claude Opus 5.5, running in Claude Code, has matched or surpassed human engineers in a new benchmark for building AI infrastructure. headline: Ukraine Calls for Winter Energy Ceasefire and Black Sea De-escalation at Berlin Meeting
reason: In a significant development towards geopolitical de-escalation, Ukrainian accounts from a meeting in Berlin on November 22, 2026, indicate a call for Russia to accept a winter energy ceasefire and de-escalation in the Black Sea. This move aims to reduce international tensions, particularly concerning energy infrastructure and maritime security.
